question: How should the numerical count progress up to the Rudra number?
premises: It increases by one each time
It ends at the Rudra number
inference: The count proceeds from one, increasing by one at a time, up to the Rudra number.
uncertainties: rudra+saṃkhyā may refer to eleven or another traditional Rudra count
plain_english: Beginning with one, increasing by one each time, indeed ending with the number of Rudras.
